visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with black and orange-streaked hair, wearing a black Tesla-branded hoodie, speaks directly into a handheld camera in a selfie-style shot. He is positioned in a spacious airport terminal where large glass windows in the background reveal an airplane on the tarmac under a grey sky. (2) The scene cuts to a wide, low-angle view of a waiting area with rows of minimalist beige chairs. Large, red rectangular pillars marked with gate numbers like D18 are prominent, and the ceiling features many oval-shaped light fixtures and exposed industrial elements. (3) The camera moves to show a retail or dining area with vending machines and glass storefronts, emphasizing the polished dark grey tiled floor that reflects the bright overhead lighting. (4) Detailed shots focus on the ceiling, highlighting the rhythmic arrangement of oval 'Halo' lights, and then transition to a unique, large white multi-nozzle air conditioning vent structure. (5) The man returns to the frame, standing in front of the terminal's open seating area and the white vent structure, gesturing broadly as he delivers his concluding remarks.
